function velocity_to_lines(vf::VelocityField)
    # Extract grid dimensions
    nx, ny, nz = vf.n[1], vf.n[2], vf.n[3]

    # Reshape velocity field to 3D array of Point3f
    u_3d = reshape(vf.u, nx, ny, nz)

    # Extract x, y, z components from xyz for grid bounds
    x = [p[1] for p in vf.xyz]
    y = [p[2] for p in vf.xyz]
    z = [p[3] for p in vf.xyz]

    # Get unique sorted grid points for each axis
    x_grid = sort(unique(x))
    y_grid = sort(unique(y))
    z_grid = sort(unique(z))

    # Convert to LinRange for interpolation
    x_range = LinRange(x_grid[1], x_grid[end], length(x_grid))
    y_range = LinRange(y_grid[1], y_grid[end], length(y_grid))
    z_range = LinRange(z_grid[1], z_grid[end], length(z_grid))
    ranges = (x_range, y_range, z_range)

    # Create a function to interpolate the velocity field at a given point
    # Returns Point3f directly
    function interpolated_vector_field(point::Point3f)
        return interpolated_getindex(u_3d, ranges, point)
    end

    # Get the streamline density from the UI settings
    streamline_density = vf.ui_states.streamline_settings

    # Create a streamplot with the interpolated vector field
    minimaxi = extrema.((x, y, z))
    mini = Vec3f(first.(minimaxi))
    maxi = Vec3f(last.(minimaxi))
    limits = Rect3f(mini, maxi .- mini)

function velocity_to_lines(vf::VelocityField)
    # Extract grid dimensions
    nx, ny, nz = vf.n[1], vf.n[2], vf.n[3]

    # Reshape velocity field to 3D array of Point3f
    u_3d = reshape(vf.u, nx, ny, nz)

    # Get grid bounds directly from xyz
    min_point, max_point = extrema(vf.xyz)
    
    # Calculate step size for each dimension
    grid_step = (max_point .- min_point) ./ Point3f(nx - 1, ny - 1, nz - 1)

    # Create a function to interpolate the velocity field at a given point
    # Returns Point3f directly
    function interpolated_vector_field(point::Point3f)
        return interpolated_getindex(u_3d, min_point, grid_step, point)
    end

    # Get the streamline density from the UI settings
    streamline_density = vf.ui_states.streamline_settings

    # Create a streamplot with the interpolated vector field
    limits = Rect3f(min_point, max_point .- min_point)
